BEHIND THE CALENDAR

Sources & coverage

Each title links to its publisher. A completed scan means the stated source was processed; it does not establish coverage of every announcement. Failed checks preserve the last verified information.

Publisher collection status and coverage limits
PublisherCollection statusScope & limitations
Bloodaxe BooksChecked24 forthcoming · last data 2026-11-09Publisher forthcoming and new-title listings; announcements outside these listings are not monitored.
Nine Arches PressChecked1 forthcoming · last data 2026-11-09Current and future year sections of the poetry catalogue, verified against individual book pages.
Shearsman BooksPartial coverage18 forthcoming · last data 2026-11-09Current and future annual catalogues discovered from the store navigation. Reissues and ambiguous prose held for review.
SerenChecked0 forthcoming · last data 2026-11-09Coming-soon catalogue only; genre and publication date checked on book pages.
The Gallery PressPartial coverage0 forthcoming · last data 2026-11-09Official rolling forthcoming and poetry RSS feeds, with book-page date and genre verification. Older undiscovered titles outside these feeds are not covered.
Faber & FaberAccess review needed0 forthcoming · no verified collectionNot collected: review reuse terms or obtain a suitable publisher feed.
Carcanet PressCollector disallowed0 forthcoming · no verified collectionNot collected: robots directives disallow the general-purpose collector. Publisher permission/feed required.
PicadorAccess review needed0 forthcoming · no verified collectionNot collected: reuse terms need review; curated imprint page is insufficient for complete discovery.
Jonathan CapeAccess review needed0 forthcoming · no verified collectionNot collected: reuse and deep-linking terms need review; curated imprint page is not comprehensive.
Dedalus PressAccess blocked0 forthcoming · no verified collectionNot collected: robots retrieval returned HTTP 403. An accessible official feed or permission is needed.
How dates and inclusion work

Exact dates cease to be forthcoming on publication day, in UK time. Month-only dates remain through month end; seasons use March–May, June–August, September–November and December–February. We show the publisher’s precision rather than an invented release day.

Poetry collections, selected and collected poems, anthologies, pamphlets and translations are in scope. Criticism, magazines, routine format reissues and uncertain hybrid works are excluded or held for review. This prototype does not claim comprehensive UK and Irish coverage.

Weekly collection and daily rebuilding are provided in the project workflow. This locally generated preview is not itself an unattended service.

Forthcoming PoetryBibliographic facts. Original sources. Something to look forward to.
